description.value: You and your convocator speak with the authority and protection of your domain. When you use Diplomacy to converse with animals, plants or spirits affiliated with a domain, even if you critically fail a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request} or to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}, your reputation ensures that their attitudes do not decrease as a result (this does not prevent it from decreasing if you are actively hostile in your Diplomacy). Creatures of these types that are of a lower level than you will immediately have a greater disposition when you first encounter them, and your Make an Impression attempts will treat their outcome as one step higher.
